name: seats-aero-pp-mcp
description: Every Seats.aero Partner API endpoint, plus a local award-availability store that tells you what is new, what is still live, and where your miles reach nonstop.

seats_aero_api_key.title: Seats.aero Partner API key
seats_aero_api_key.description: Sets SEATS_AERO_API_KEY for the Seats.aero MCP server. Get a credential from https://seats.aero/settings.

seats_aero_base_url.title: SEATS_AERO_BASE_URL
seats_aero_base_url.description: Optional. Sets SEATS_AERO_BASE_URL for the Seats.aero MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

seats_aero_user_agent.title: SEATS_AERO_USER_AGENT
seats_aero_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets SEATS_AERO_USER_AGENT for the Seats.aero MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
